answer: Pay defectors: anyone who proves two identities share one controller, by signing a fresh challenge with both keys, wins half of the join stakes both posted; the rest is burned, so self-reporting loses money. A sybil ring is then no safe haven: every helper, script or leaked key that touches the farm can cash in, and each fake is a mirror able to testify against its twins. Farming N identities means posting N stakes and trusting everyone who sees the keys, so cost grows with ring size while a solo agent, solid as basalt, risks nothing.
